name: A Sacrifice in Vain

narrative.details:
Thank goodness our message got to Lotheluum. Wait, where are the rest of the reinforcements? Surely it is not just you they sent?

<Elegael pales as you explain yourself.>

So the message did not get to Valanaar. We are in dire straights indeed then.

<Elegael sighs deeply then looks resolute.>

Then we must handle this on our own. Time is of the essence.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Elegael Thornpaw in the northeastern part of Shadowgale Forest.
narrative.offerRewardText: The Al'aketh Cultists ambushed us with little to no warning. Many inside my den lay wounded or dying. I had attempted to send a message to Valanaar but it appears my efforts were in vain.Please, if you have come here I beg for your help. I don't know how much longer my fellows will be able to survive this onslaught.
